description.value: Kisokoma is a family-owned Japanese restaurant on West Broadway that has been serving sushi, rolls, donburi, and Japanese comfort food since 1999, growing its menu to over 250 items. Operated by the same Vietnamese family who opened it, the restaurant is steps from Vancouver General Hospital and draws a loyal lunch crowd from the surrounding medical district. Online ordering via UberEats and an in-house catering service make it a convenient stop for groups or cyclists needing a quick, substantial meal.
